panels.title: Sensors (last status)

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: -15m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_status")
  |> last()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["device","link"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["device","link","state","online","alarm","csi_link","calib_pct","wifi_rssi","uptime_s"])
  |> group()

panels.description: Status messages are retained, but only the last 15 minutes are shown: a silent device drops out of the table.

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_event" and (r._field == "p_person"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.event == "alarm_start")
  |> group()
  |> count()

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_event" and (r._field == "p_person"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.event == "link_lost")
  |> group()
  |> count()

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_status" and (r._field == "alarm"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_event" and r._field == "confidence")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time","device","link","event","class","_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "confidence"})
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_metrics" and (r._field == "p_person"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Feature distribution: window energy (drift)

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_metrics" and (r._field == "energy" or r._field == "energy_avg"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

panels.description: Mean squared normalized amplitude of the window. In an empty room it should stay near the value measured right after calibration. A slow rise means drift: recalibrate.

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_metrics" and (r._field == "infer_us_avg" or r._field == "infer_us_max"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Free heap (min since boot)

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_metrics" and (r._field == "heap_min" or r._field == "heap_free"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

panels.description: Step 4.8: must stay flat over 24 h (no leaks).

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_metrics" and (r._field == "gaps" or r._field == "queue_drops"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
